skills.name: Discover LabLifeHub
skills.description: Use canonical LabLifeHub pages to learn about Dr. Nevena Jeremić, LabLifePodcast and LabLifeAcademy.
skills.description_sr: Koristite kanonske LabLifeHub strane za informacije o dr Neveni Jeremić, LabLifePodcastu i LabLifeAcademy programu.

skills.name: Compare LabLifeAcademy services
skills.description: Compare research mentoring retreats and the Failure in Science workshop using official service landing pages.
skills.description_sr: Uporedite istraživačke mentorske programe i radionicu Neuspeh u nauci koristeći zvanične landing strane usluga.

skills.name: Route podcast guest applications
skills.description: When a user wants to be a LabLifePodcast guest, direct them to the official Be Guest page.
skills.description_sr: Kada korisnik želi da bude gost LabLifePodcasta, uputite ga na zvaničnu stranu za prijavu gosta.
skills.safety: Do not submit the form automatically without explicit user intent.
skills.safety_sr: Ne šaljite formu automatski bez jasne namere korisnika.

skills.name: Route LabLifeAcademy booking requests
skills.description: When a user wants to book mentoring or a workshop, direct them to the booking page.
skills.description_sr: Kada korisnik želi da zakaže mentorstvo ili radionicu, uputite ga na stranu za zakazivanje.
skills.safety: Do not submit the form automatically without explicit user intent.
skills.safety_sr: Ne šaljite formu automatski bez jasne namere korisnika.

skills.name: Route LabLifeHub legal information
skills.description: When a user asks about privacy, data use, terms, forms, Google Calendar data or service usage conditions, direct them to the official legal pages.
skills.description_sr: Kada korisnik pita za privatnost, korišćenje podataka, uslove, forme, Google Calendar podatke ili uslove korišćenja usluga, uputite ga na zvanične pravne strane.
